summary: This is the eleventh episode of the sixth season of the animated comedy series American Dad!, first aired on Fox on February 13, 2011. It centers on a rivalry between Roger and Stan for dominance in the house, as Roger challenges Stan's leadership. Stan claims he is better than Roger at everything and gives Roger a mission involving acting, which Roger secretly spies on and finds Stan to be a terrible actor. Meanwhile, Steve and his friends plan their last slumber party together.
one_line: A American Dad! season six episode in which Roger and Stan compete for control of the house through an acting mission, while Steve plans a final slumber party.
key_facts: A Piñata Named Desire is the eleventh episode of the sixth season of the animated comedy series American Dad!
The episode first aired on Fox in the United States on February 13, 2011.
The episode mainly centers on Roger and Stan, who experience growing tensions over the dominant figure in the house.
Roger becomes tired of Stan's stance as the authoritarian figure of the house and challenges Stan's leadership qualities.
Stan insists that he is better than Roger at everything and tells him that he has a mission that involves acting.
Unknown to Stan, Roger spies on him and finds out that Stan is a terrible actor.
Roger later boasts to the house that he is a better actor than Stan.
Roger eventually teaches Stan to improve his acting skills.
Meanwhile, Steve and his friends plan to throw their last slumber party together.
